purpose: Shared source contract proposal for source-qualified player/team/event report facts. It does not estimate target redistribution, health, starter probability or participation.

required_clocks.source_updated_UTC: Nullable only if a documented source clock exists
required_clocks.authenticated_original_availability_UTC: Nullable; never synthesized from week,kickoff,HTTPDate or current observation
required_clocks.event_effective_UTC: Nullable unless roster/status source establishes applicability

field_state_encoding.numeric_zero: Preserve as value0 when a numeric field is genuinely reported; designation data are categorical
field_state_encoding.report_status: Provider official game-report designation; no null/notlisted=>healthy rule
field_state_encoding.expected_role: UNKNOWN unless separate qualified pregame role evidence exists
field_state_encoding.participation: Unknown future outcome, not inferred from report/practice status
field_state_encoding.statistic_zero: Not implied by Out/IR/missing row; final participation and outcome grading stay separate

universe_contract.basic_board: Every eligible canonical pregame roster/player record or explicit unavailable record, not target stat appearances
universe_contract.injury_subset: Injury feed cannot be the full universe; no missingrow=>healthy
universe_contract.teammates: Retain unprofiled/sparse/unknown players and other/unallocated opportunity bucket
universe_contract.historical_team: Requires event-effective mapping; current team cannot be copied backwards

compatibility.B_reuse: Same generic status identity/clock contract may be consumed through C existing intake index; no B files or fits executed here
compatibility.source_freshness: Use existing source-specific prospective policy; no new timing lag chosen
compatibility.outcomes: No future outcomes needed for a legitimate query

readiness: Source contract definition only; no mechanism fit, probability law, current role admission or model release
